profile.name: Marcus Hill
profile.summary: Line cook with 4 years in scratch kitchens and high-volume fast-casual restaurants. ServSafe certified, calm under pressure and a strong team player.

descriptions: Work grill, sauté and prep stations, rotating weekly across a 6-station line
Cook 300+ covers per lunch rush while keeping ticket times under 8 minutes
Follow recipe cards and portion guides for seasonal menus
Keep the station clean and log fridge temperatures for the health inspection
Train new prep cooks on knife skills and plating standards
Prepped vegetables, sauces and proteins for a 120-seat diner
Covered the dish station when the team was short-staffed
